blockingIssues.problem: The rationale asserts the committee continued the trial “because the germination results convinced it that the dry cupboard was promising,” but the source does not document that motive and explicitly notes no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source states only that “At its March meeting, the committee chose to keep the same two lots in the cupboard for another six months and repeat the germination check.” It also states “The notes give no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement and no promise of better garden results,” and documents limits on inference (different harvest lots, temperature logged only in the new cupboard, no paired comparison, no garden performance measured).
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not present the committee’s motive or an implied causal judgment about the cupboard as established fact; the piece must stick to the documented decision and the uncertainty about causation and committee reasoning.
